summary: Two independent R3 reviews agree that v28 closes the per-T projection, nullable sort, nested transaction core, generation activation, no-replacement budget, exact check IDs and clean-environment direction, but it omits canonical event artifacts and live guards, lacks an idempotent terminal reconciler and two-branch generation mapping, mismatches official single-horizon behavior manifests, regresses M7 loader/checkpoint/CCC details, uses -I despite PYTHONHASHSEED, and leaves final directory durability, marker mode and private TMPDIR incomplete.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
